BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to obesity lawsuits; and adding a new section tochapter 7.72 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 7.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Any manufacturer, distributor, or seller of a food ornonalcoholic beverage intended for human consumption shall not besubject to civil liability for personal injury or wrongful death basedon an individual's consumption of food or nonalcoholic beverages incases where liability is premised upon the individual's weight gain,obesity, or a health condition related to weight gain or obesity andresulting from the individual's longterm consumption of a food ornonalcoholic beverage. (2) For the purposes of this section, the term "longtermconsumption" means the cumulative effect of the consumption of food ornonalcoholic beverages, and not the effect of a single instance ofconsumption.
